aboutUs.title: Bridging Ethiopian Families, Learners & Organizations with Vetted Educators
aboutUs.intro: TutorBridge Ethiopia is a managed hybrid tutoring marketplace and organizational training coordination platform founded in Addis Ababa. We simplify how families find trustworthy private teachers and how organizations deliver high-impact workforce capacity building.
aboutUs.storyBody: Across Ethiopia, parents often rely on unverified word-of-mouth referrals when seeking home tutors, while qualified teachers struggle to find steady, fairly compensated students. At the same time, companies, NGOs, and institutions frequently lack a single dependable partner to source, screen, contract, and track specialized local trainers. TutorBridge was built to solve all three gaps under one trusted intermediary—verifying identity and academic credentials, protecting learner safety, and managing transparent Telebirr, CBE Birr, and bank-verified payments.
aboutUs.missionBody: To simplify finding, verifying, and booking qualified tutors and professional trainers while creating dignified, transparent income opportunities for Ethiopian educators.
aboutUs.visionBody: To become Ethiopia's most trusted education and workforce training bridge—connecting every learner and institution with the right educator nationwide.

faqs.question: How does TutorBridge verify tutors and corporate trainers?
faqs.answer: Every individual tutor and corporate trainer submits a valid national ID, academic or professional qualifications, undergoes competency and experience verification, and receives administrator approval before taking assignments.

faqs.question: Can companies, NGOs, and government offices request customized staff training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through Division 4 (Corporate & Organizational Training), organizations can register an account, submit a training request across Digital Literacy, IT, Marketing & Business, Leadership, or Creative Tech, and receive customized trainer proposals and itemized quotations.

faqs.question: How do itemized corporate quotations work?
faqs.answer: Every corporate quotation transparently breaks down trainer compensation, logistical expenses, and TutorBridge service fees based on program duration, participant numbers, subject complexity, and venue.

faqs.question: How do Telebirr, CBE Birr, and Bank Transfer payments work?
faqs.answer: For both individual tutoring bookings and corporate training invoices, you submit your Telebirr, CBE Birr, or bank transfer reference inside your dashboard, and TutorBridge verifies the transaction and records receipts.

sections.heading: 1. Parental Consent & Transparency
sections.body: Separate student profiles for minors require explicit parent or legal guardian consent. Parents receive clear scheduling details, attendance records, and learning progress updates for every session.

sections.heading: 2. Tutor Vetting & Conduct Rules
sections.body: Before public approval, every tutor undergoes national ID verification, educational credential checks, reference verification, and must sign our Safeguarding Conduct Code.

sections.heading: 3. Safe In-Person Locations & Reporting
sections.body: All in-person tutoring occurs strictly at parent-approved family or safeguarded locations. Any concern or safeguarding incident can be reported immediately through the Support & Safeguarding channel in your dashboard.

sections.heading: 1. Marketplace Intermediary Role
sections.body: TutorBridge Ethiopia acts as an intermediary connecting families and learners with independent verified educators and skills instructors.

sections.heading: 2. Transparent 15% Commission
sections.body: A 15% platform commission applies to completed tutoring transactions to cover tutor verification, managed matching, payment verification, and family support. Tutors receive 85% of completed bookings.

sections.heading: 3. Bookings & Payments
sections.body: Bookings require tutor availability confirmation and verified manual payment (Telebirr, CBE Birr, or Bank Transfer) prior to starting sessions.

sections.heading: 1. Minimal Necessary Data
sections.body: We collect only information required to coordinate safe tutoring matches, verify educator credentials, and track authorized bookings and payments.

sections.heading: 2. Strict Isolation of Sensitive Records
sections.body: National identification numbers, educational certificates, phone numbers, and minor student profiles are never exposed in public tutor listings.

sections.heading: 3. Access Control
sections.body: Student profiles are accessible solely to the owning parent account and authorized TutorBridge administrators.
